profile.input_contract: JSON point-kinetics parameters, time grid, and initial power/precursor state.
profile.output_contract: JSON scalar power and precursor response metrics.
profile.adapter: Pure-stdlib Python runner and JSON parser/adapter under SUT/minimum_mr_subset_p5/.

mrs.description: Power-response monotonicity: for the same initial delayed-neutron precursor state and time interval, scaling the positive reactivity insertion rho upward must strictly increase the maximum reactor power response observed over the transient.

explanation_profile.meta_pattern_rationale: Mono MR: increasing positive reactivity in the same point-kinetics transient increases the maximum power response.
explanation_profile.transformation_semantics: Apply ScaleField to /kinetics/rho with factor=2; all other kinetic and initial-state parameters remain unchanged.
explanation_profile.observable_summary: Observe `max_power` from source and follow-up outputs for MR `p5-power-response`.
explanation_profile.predicate_summary: Predicate `greater` / `GreaterThan` checks that follow-up max_power is strictly greater than source max_power.
explanation_profile.tolerance_summary: Ordinal deterministic predicate: no numeric tolerance is applied beyond the declared ordering relation.
explanation_profile.applicability: Applicable when the SUT exposes /kinetics/rho in the JSON input and outputs scalar `max_power` from a deterministic point-kinetics transient.
explanation_profile.failure_meaning: Failure indicates the solver, adapter, or transform binding violated the expected positive-reactivity power response relation.
